sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT substr(t.txn_date,1,4) year,c.category_code,c.category_name,ROUND(AVG(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]),2) avg_wp,ROUND(MAX(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]),2) max_wp,ROUND(MIN(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]),2) min_wp,ROUND(MAX(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg])-MIN(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]),2) diff_wp,ROUND(SUM(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]),2) cost,ROUND(SUM(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]),2) revenue_float,ROUND(SUM(CAST(ROUND(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*1000) AS INTEGER)*CAST(ROUND(t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]*100) AS INTEGER))/100000.0,2) revenue_exact,ROUND(AVG(l.[loss_rate_%]),2) avg_rate FROM veg_txn_df t JOIN veg_whsle_df w ON t.item_code=w.item_code AND t.txn_date=w.whsle_date JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code=c.item_code JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON t.item_code=l.item_code WHERE t.[sale/return]='sale' GROUP BY year,c.category_code,c.category_name) SELECT *,ROUND(cost*avg_rate/100.0,2) loss,ROUND(revenue_exact-cost-ROUND(cost*avg_rate/100.0,2),2) profit FROM agg ORDER BY year,category_code
